title: Correlation context middleware for cross-service span consistency
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Implement a lightweight correlation-context middleware that standardizes propagation of trace/span identifiers, Baggage entries, and deterministic sampling overrides across Redwood SDKs, edge proxies, and backend services. The goal is to ensure span attribute consistency (service.name, model.variant, route_id, correlation_id) so latency and error dashboards can reliably group and attribute requests across hops. This middleware must be OpenTelemetry-compatible, provide an opt-in PII-scrubbing hook, and expose a small API for SDKs to attach structured metadata without duplicating heavy tracing implementations.
acceptance_criteria: Middleware library published for Node and Go with the same API surface and documented initialization
Propagation headers used align with our OTLP/OTel recommendations and interop with existing edge proxies
End-to-end test shows a request with 3 hops retains correlation_id, route_id, and sampling decision
Latency dashboard metrics can filter and aggregate by route_id and model.variant for cross-service traces
PII-scrubbing hook is present and enabled by default for public deployments; enterprise builds can opt-out
Load test shows <2% p99 latency impact for typical request volumes when middleware enabled
